definitions: To stand up, especially from a sitting or prone position.
To rebel or revolt against authority or oppression.
To emerge or appear, often in a prominent or noticeable way.
To increase in height, level, or intensity.
examples: The people will rise up against the dictator.
A new city will rise up from the ashes.
He watched the sun rise up over the mountains.
The water levels began to rise up rapidly.
